While 'T' is likely a typo for 'I' in the source text, the claim also implies that G and B of I *alone* (or with A) determine the addresses, but the text specifies that G and B of I/T determine the *s* coordinates (codeword index), while A determines the *t* coordinate (relative address). *   B-component: Index into $C_2$ [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the B-component is used to index into $C_2$. The evidence explicitly states: 'The difference vectors are indexed via the G- and Bcomponents, and they are fetched from the dependent textures C1 and C2.' Furthermore, it clarifies the specific mapping: 'In the R-component of A, 64 different addresses are coded to index C1. In the G-component, however, only 8 different addresses have to be coded to assign the codewords in C2.' While the text mentions the G-component of the Address Texture A is used for C2, it also states that 'the G- and B-component of T [the index texture] together with the R- and G-component of A uniquely determine the addresses into the dependent textures C1 and C2'. Specifically, the B-component of the index texture (I) is one of the components used to index the difference vectors fetched from C2. Therefore, the evidence supports the fact that the B-component is involved in indexing C2.
